Champion rules rely on open‑interest dropping into bottom 5% and combine with volume, RSI or crowd ratios.
These champion rules achieve mean returns 0.17‑0.56, hit rates 51‑55%, t‑stats 2.0‑2.8, p‑values ≤0.035.
No champion rule has been live yet; live count is zero across all.
Strategies using crowd long/short ratio bottom 5% plus top‑trader ratio bottom 30% show the strongest signals.
Overall, the system finds modest but statistically significant long opportunities, mainly in low open‑interest, low RSI, and low crowd sentiment conditions.
